bull.b: Retreatment data support the durability and repeat-use potential of Descartes-08 in generalized myasthenia gravis. Sustained symptom improvement through 12 months, together with planned Phase 3 and regulatory activity, could advance the lead program toward a commercial opportunity.

Transient mRNA engineering provides a distinct approach to cell therapy by seeking targeted activity without permanent genetic alteration. If the platform continues to demonstrate clinical utility, this design could support broader development across autoimmune diseases and selected cancers.

A pipeline spanning multiple autoimmune indications and selected cancers gives Cartesian more than one potential path to clinical value. Progress in one disease area may also validate the underlying platform and improve the prospects for advancing related programs.

bear.b: Without an approved product, Cartesian lacks recurring commercial revenue to fund operations and validate its business model. Financial progress therefore remains dependent on clinical execution, potential partnerships, and external financing until a program reaches commercialization.

The sharp revenue contraction alongside a substantial net loss shows that current operating scale is far below the level needed to support ongoing expenses. This weak earnings base increases dependence on future clinical milestones and capital access over the next several quarters.

Persistent operating and free-cash-flow deficits consume resources while negative equity reduces balance-sheet flexibility. Together, these conditions can increase reliance on external funding and create dilution or financing pressure as Cartesian advances expensive clinical programs.
